description: Figure 8 illustrates the results of layer-wise quantized pruning on the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model, using SnapKV as the pruning method with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The chart plots the relative change in performance on the y-axis, which ranges from -25% to 5%, against the model layers on the x-axis, which are divided into five segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. Four distinct lines represent different experimental configurations: 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit' (yellow, solid line with circle markers), 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit' (red, solid line with square markers), 'RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit' (light blue, solid line with triangle markers), and 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit' (dark blue, solid line with diamond markers). A dashed grey line represents the 'Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit' performance. The performance of all methods shows a significant drop in the Layer13-20 segment, with the 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit' method experiencing the most severe decline, reaching approximately -23%. The 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit' method shows the least performance degradation, with a relative change of about -10% in the same layer. The performance of all methods recovers in the final layers (Layer21-28 and Layer29-32), with the 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit' method showing a sharp increase to a relative change of approximately -5% in Layer29-32.
